name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, we won't make any progress if we don't. Ahh, my shoulders are so stiff」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In other words, it was all effort for nothing」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen! As the chosen representatives selected by the democratic will of the entire student body to guide them properly, striving diligently is our noble duty」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, you don't need to be so rigid about it. As long as we do our best with what we can, that's good enough」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just as expected of someone with huge boobs, Senpai's words are impressive too」
Everyone's gaze somehow drifts toward a very specific spot.

name: Synn
message: 「What she's saying has nothing to do with her b-boobs~! The incident is happening at the scene!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, having big boobs is super important」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm, well, you see, that's not what I meant... j-jeez」

name: Misa
message: 「All of you are being far too vulgar. Regardless of chest size, Onee-sama's words are admirable」
Misa steals a quick glance at her senior's chest.
What is this strange, nagging feeling......

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Being this scatterbrained, do you really think you're fit to hold a post?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. That's what they call the pot calling the kettle black. In this case, if we're talking about who's the pot and who's the kettle」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll be sure to gather your bones for you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, he's just heading back to the academy, isn't he」

name: Paqy
message: 「Taking on a Demon all alone might be bad news」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. I feel like it's something else」

name: Paqy
message: 「Leave it to the mysterious transfer student to act just as mysteriously」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Hmm. No matter how many times I look at 'em, they're small.」
Azel climbed out of the water in front of us.
Her water-drenched short hair glistened glossily.

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Impressive as always, Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not satisfied with just the Student Council girls--excluding Ria-chan--you're already sizing up new targets to spread your tentacles further. A hero truly loves his--」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're asking who I am... I'm the Student Council President, Synn Sakura!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ahem. Listen. You aren't allowed to use the pool without permission. I figured you probably didn't know since you're a transfer student, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I didn't really see anything! Like you changing or anything like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's why I didn't see. I said I didn't see.」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't. Everyone makes mistakes, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I won't tell a soul, it's a secret just between the two of us.」

name: Azel
message: 「If you tell, I'll kill you. Even if a rumor spreads, I'll kill you.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't just jump into the pool without permission!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thanks for covering for me, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it seemed like you didn't want to run into Azel, Paqy. Still, why is that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, well, I just kinda don't feel like seeing her. Still, a Great Sage's intuition is spot-on. Just as accurate as blood type horoscopes.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Impressive as always, Demon Lord. Calling it a secret just between the two of us on the spot--those suggestive lines roll right off your tongue.」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyone who says stuff like that gets this!」
